source: skills/ui-evaluator/references/knowledge/cjk.md: zh strings for CPY-02 and CPY-04, I18N-16, I18N-17 (canonical terms) and I18N-18 (jargon review list); QUALITY-BAR CPY-02 and CPY-04 name the gate strings.
note: Patterns are JavaScript regular-expression sources matched with the u flag. Strings beyond the ones QUALITY-BAR names are UI-Evaluator renderings of the English lists and carry `heuristic: true` ([heuristic] in cjk.md). 请 and 抱歉 are idiomatic and never CPY-04 hits; 抱歉 for a user's own mistake is advisory (CPY-09, I18N-16). No openly licensed Chinese words-to-avoid list exists, so I18N-18 is a review prompt, never evidence for SLP-14.

error_generic.description: Fail when shown without a cause and a fix (generic), or when a code stands alone. Patterns match whole messages.

entries.note: fails without a reason or fix

link_text_vague.description: Fail when the link's whole accessible name is one of these and its programmatic context (sentence, list item, table cell or aria-describedby) does not say where it leads. Implements WCAG 2.4.4, so it cannot be waived.

placeholder_text.description: zh placeholder copy left in shipped UI. cjk.md names no zh list for CPY-01; these are UI-Evaluator renderings of the English list. CPY-01 reports a heuristic entry only when it is most of the string (a UI label that is the placeholder), not when prose mentions it.

entries.pattern: (?:此处|这里)(?:输入|填写|放置)(?:文字|文案|内容)

placeholder_identities.description: Stock zh placeholder people and companies (UI-Evaluator rendering of the English lexicon; SLP-13 says 'and similar'). Person names match only standalone, after a label (负责人：) or before a particle or title (的, 先生), because Chinese text has no spaces between words.

entries.pattern: (?:(?<!\p{Script=Han})|(?<=(?:姓名|名字|用户|用户名|联系人|负责人|作者|客户|员工|学生|老师|收件人|发件人|业主|顾客|会员|讲师|医生|患者|经办人|申请人)[：:]?))张三(?!丰)(?=$|[^\p{Script=Han}]|的|等|先生|女士|同学|老师|和|与|、)
entries.note: 张三丰 is a historical figure; matches only as a standalone name (not inside a longer word such as 主张三段式)

jargon_review.description: Workplace jargon to flag in user-facing copy and rewrite around what the product does. Each hit is judged by sense; technical meanings pass (链路 in network tracing, 矩阵 in mathematics), as does quoted user language.
sources: 半月谈评论员 张曦, via 中国网, 2024-02-05

entries.text: 矩阵 (as in 触达矩阵)
心智 (as in 击穿心智)

canonical_terms.description: One term per concept across the zh-CN catalogue; record the choice in the DESIGN.md glossary.

not: 添加 and 新增 for the same action
entries.note: Semi's choice; any one term, used consistently

not_hits.description: Idiomatic in Chinese; never CPY-04 hits.

entries.note: only for faults the system caused; for the user's own mistake it is advisory (CPY-09, I18N-16)
